request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Paint the buggy's whole body plain bright red with a darker red shadow, never crimson or purple, and make the driver's face yellow-olive green. Keep the spiked grey ram, the dark wheels, the exhaust with its soot puff, the driver's red cap and goggles, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
